positive_cases.name: domain_admins_addition
positive_cases.scenario: Member added to a privileged domain group.
positive_cases.rationale: Both the event identifier and the group selections match.

positive_cases.name: local_administrators_addition
positive_cases.scenario: Member added to the local administrators group.
positive_cases.rationale: Both the event identifier and the group selections match.

negative_cases.name: application_group_addition
negative_cases.scenario: Member added to an application access group.
negative_cases.rationale: The privileged group selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: privileged_group_removal
negative_cases.scenario: Member removed from a privileged group.
negative_cases.rationale: The event identifier selection covers additions only.

negative_cases.name: security_group_created
negative_cases.rationale: The event identifier selection does not match.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
